title: sherpa harness state
description: What sherpa owns in the repo and the hash it wrote (.sherpa/state.json). Written by `sherpa apply`, read by `apply`, `status` and the outcome hook (harness_rev).

sherpa.description: sherpa version that wrote the state

harness_rev.description: hash over every managed file/block hash plus the sherpa version; stamped on outcome labels

plan.description: trunk, rev and as_of of the applied plan

applied_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC of the last write — the only clock in apply

mode.description: managed = whole file; blocks = marked blocks only; json-hooks = merged hook entries

entry.description: kind/target/scope of the plan entry; absent for base files

hash.description: content hash, line endings normalised (managed, json-hooks)

blocks.description: block name → hash of the inner text
